tenderSchedule.description: Providing samiyana services to KFA Dharwad

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka Forest Academy, Garag Road, Gungaragatti , Dharwad-580011

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidders shall submit a valid Forest Contractor Registration Certificate for the financial year 2026 27 issued by the Joint Director and Deputy Conservator of Forests Karnataka Forest Academy Gungaragatti, Dharwad
The bidder shall submit a certificate demonstrating a minimum level of experience in providing Shamiyana services to at least 5,000 people per day
The bidder shall submit a self-attested copy of the Permanent Account Number PAN Card issued by the Income Tax Department as documentary evidence
The bidder shall submit a valid Goods and Services Tax GST Registration Certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence of GST registration
The bidder shall submit an last 3years Annual Turnover Certificate duly certified by a Chartered Accountant
The bidder shall submit copies of the Last 3 years Income Tax Returns
The bidder shall submit details of the utensils and Shamiyana equipment required for serving along with relevant supporting certificates

The bidder shall submit documentary evidence demonstrating a minimum of 3 years of experience in the supply and provision of Shamiyana services, along with proof of an annual turnover of at least Rs. 50.00 lakh
The bidder shall Submit work done certificate on providing Shamiyana services to government or large organizations in the last three years Preference will be given to those from Dharwad District
